theme: An open Friday — Toronto prep and a Halloween eve.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — no meetings, the girls here in St. Pete, and Halloween tomorrow. The open space is yours; the Toronto panel and two overdue bookings are what's quietly waiting.

needsAttention.title: Fold Jen's questions into your run of show
needsAttention.detail: Flo at ICGN forwarded Jen's reshaped session questions and asked if you can work them into the Plenary 7 plan. You moderate that stewardship panel Thursday in Toronto, so the run of show is the agenda you'll open with.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task has been sitting since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the one that sells out — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Shortlist the December break
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sept 30, and the book-by Oct 15 has already passed. Six people over three weeks of holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, so the shortlist and a direction are the gating step.

flagged.title: Maine feedback circling NACD New England
flagged.detail: Rich Stone emailed the NACD New England group you're on — a chain to glance at, nothing owed from you yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is a St. Pete newsletter, a BBYO reunion Evite update, and Nextdoor's trick-or-treat nudge.

resolved.title: Toronto comp pass is registered
resolved.detail: Claudia at ICGN confirmed your complimentary conference place — nothing to sort on the ticket.

resolved.title: Panel outline cleared by co-panelists
resolved.detail: Jane (BNP Paribas) and Andy (Schroders) both signed off on your run of show; Rachit is finalizing the questions with ICGN.
